import subprocess, sys, hashlib
def run(env=None):
    import os
    e = dict(os.environ)
    if env: e.update(env)
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/cli.py'],
                       stdin=open('cases/mem3.json','rb'), capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace', env=e)
    return hashlib.sha256(p.stdout).hexdigest(), p.returncode
h = [run()[0] for _ in range(3)]
print('same-process determinism:', len(set(h))==1, h[0][:16])
print('hashseed random         :', run({'PYTHONHASHSEED':'random'})[0][:16])
print('hashseed 12345          :', run({'PYTHONHASHSEED':'12345'})[0][:16])
